 Learn more Take-Two Interactive ( TTWO ) shares surge 5% as excitement builds ahead of the anticipated November 18 launch of Grand Theft Auto VI. With reports of more than $1.5 billion in preorders, the highly anticipated game could become one of the biggest entertainment launches in history. 
 "The 8:30" hosts Julie Hyman, Pras Subramanian, and Jake Conley discuss the hype surrounding GTA VI and what its blockbuster potential could mean for Take-Two investors.
